external_entities.name: member
external_entities.source_excerpt: Members collect points when they shop and spend them on gift cards.

external_entities.name: members' phone
external_entities.description: A member's phone running the mobile app and holding its refresh token.
external_entities.source_excerpt: The app keeps a refresh token on the phone.

external_entities.name: partner app
external_entities.description: A web application operated by another company, such as a meal-planning service that shows a member's points.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Partner apps are web applications that other companies run on their own servers

processes.name: mobile app
processes.description: The mobile application signs members in and calls the rewards API.

processes.name: authorization server
processes.description: The authorization server authenticates members, handles authorization and consent, and issues authorization codes, refresh tokens and access tokens.
processes.source_excerpt: The authorization server keeps member accounts, email addresses and password hashes

processes.name: rewards API
processes.description: The API serves loyalty rewards operations and reads and writes the points ledger.
processes.source_excerpt: The rewards API reads and writes the points ledger

processes.name: support console
processes.description: A web application that closes a member's account.
processes.source_excerpt: The support console is a web app that closes a member's account.

data_stores.name: identity database
data_stores.description: Stores member accounts, email addresses, password hashes, authorization codes, refresh tokens and consents.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The authorization server keeps member accounts, email addresses and password hashes in the identity database

data_stores.name: points ledger
data_stores.description: Stores every member's balance and every points transaction.
data_stores.source_excerpt: the points ledger, which holds every member's balance and every points transaction

data_stores.name: API log store
data_stores.description: Stores every request received by the rewards API, including headers.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The rewards API also writes every request it receives, headers included, to the API log store.

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: The mobile app signs a member in through the authorization server using the authorization code flow.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The app signs a member in through our authorization server with the authorization code flow
data_flows.notes: The source does not state whether the app sends a PKCE challenge.

data_flows.name: call rewards API
data_flows.description: The mobile app calls the rewards API with an access token.
data_flows.source_excerpt: then calls the rewards API with the access token it gets back

data_flows.name: sign in and consent
data_flows.description: A member signs in on the authorization server's sign-in page and approves the consent screen.
data_flows.source_excerpt: A member who connects a partner app signs in on the authorization server's sign-in page in their browser and approves a consent screen
data_flows.data_description: Member sign-in and consent for partner-app scopes

data_flows.name: request authorization
data_flows.description: A partner app requests authorization from the authorization server.
data_flows.source_excerpt: A member who connects a partner app
data_flows.notes: The authorization request is implied by the described partner-app connection flow.

data_flows.name: return authorization code
data_flows.description: The authorization server returns an authorization code to the partner app's redirect URI.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The browser then returns to the partner app's redirect URI with an authorization code.
data_flows.notes: The browser-mediated redirect is represented as an authorization-server-to-partner-app callback.

data_flows.name: request token
data_flows.description: The partner app sends a token request containing its client secret in the request body.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The partner app sends that secret in the body of its token requests.
data_flows.data_description: Client credentials and authorization-code token request

data_flows.name: show points
data_flows.description: A partner app calls the rewards API to show a member's points.
data_flows.source_excerpt: such as a meal-planning service that shows a member's points

data_flows.name: store identity data
data_flows.description: The authorization server stores member identity and authorization data in the identity database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The authorization server keeps member accounts, email addresses and password hashes in the identity database, together with the authorization codes, refresh tokens and consents it issues.
data_flows.data_description: Member accounts, email addresses, password hashes, authorization codes, refresh tokens and consents

data_flows.name: delete refresh token
data_flows.description: The authorization server deletes a partner app's refresh token when a member disconnects it.
data_flows.source_excerpt: which deletes that app's refresh token from the identity database

data_flows.name: update points ledger
data_flows.description: The rewards API reads and writes the points ledger, including points redemptions.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The rewards API reads and writes the points ledger
data_flows.notes: Redeeming points for a gift card requires a valid access token carrying the redeem scope.

data_flows.name: write request logs
data_flows.description: The rewards API writes every received request and its headers to the API log store.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The rewards API also writes every request it receives, headers included, to the API log store.

data_flows.name: obtain access token
data_flows.description: The support console takes access tokens from the authorization server.
data_flows.source_excerpt: It takes access tokens from the same authorization server
data_flows.notes: The token acquisition mechanism is not stated.

data_flows.name: close account
data_flows.description: The support console marks a member's account closed in the identity database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Closing an account marks it closed in the identity database.

trust_boundaries.name: our cloud account
trust_boundaries.description: The cloud account in which the platform components and stores run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Everything below runs in our own cloud account

trust_boundaries.name: members' phones
trust_boundaries.description: The member-controlled phones on which the mobile app and refresh tokens reside.

trust_boundaries.name: partner apps' own servers
trust_boundaries.description: Servers controlled by the other companies that operate the partner apps.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Partner apps are web applications that other companies run on their own servers

assumptions.assumption: The identity database contains confidential data because it stores member personal information, password hashes, tokens and consents.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the store contains member accounts, email addresses, password hashes, authorization codes, refresh tokens and consents.

assumptions.assumption: The points ledger contains confidential data because it stores member balances and transactions, including gift-card redemptions.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the ledger holds every member's balance and every points transaction and supports gift-card redemption.

assumptions.assumption: The API log store contains confidential data because request headers may contain bearer tokens and requests may contain member-related data.
assumptions.basis: The source states that every request received by the rewards API, headers included, is written to the log store.

assumptions.assumption: The rewards API is internet-facing because it is served on the same public hostname as the support console.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the support console is served on the same public hostname as the rewards API.

assumptions.assumption: The support console is internet-facing because it is served on a public hostname.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the support console is served on the same public hostname as the rewards API.
